payload.rebuttal: fixed: Every assertion built its expected string with f"{PUSHED}..." or f"{ESCALATE}...", so a change to either constant moved the expected value and the actual output together and no test could notice. I added direct assertions that PUSHED == "pushed " and ESCALATE == "escalate: ", and rewrote every expected-line construction in both witnesses to use the literal text instead of re-importing the symbol. I confirmed the fix by hand-applying the exact mutant from the finding (PUSHED = "shipped ") and watching the test fail, then reverted the mutant.
